necessary_context.content: At t=1,...,T choose w_t in W before observing differentiable convex f_t. Reg_T(u)=sum_t[f_t(w_t)-f_t(u_t)], P_T(u)=sum_{t=2}^T ||u_t-u_{t-1}||_2. Full information allows loss and gradient evaluations at additional points after revelation; evaluations, projections and arithmetic are separately counted.
necessary_context.name: Online protocol and metric

necessary_context.content: W is nonempty compact convex, diameter at most D>0; every loss is eta-exp-concave, meaning exp(-eta f) is concave, and ||grad f||_2<=G. gamma=min{eta/2,1/(4GD)}, lambda=gamma/2, Lambda_T=1+log(2T). Upper implementations use an exact Mahalanobis projection oracle for every positive-definite metric at cost C_proj(d).
necessary_context.name: Geometry and curvature

necessary_context.content: Upper bounds hold for every realized admissible loss sequence and comparator path. Lower bounds use an oblivious distribution, then averaging gives a deterministic worst sequence/comparator pair for each randomized learner; expectation is over learner randomness. No probability-2/3 guarantee is asserted.
necessary_context.name: Guarantee distinction
